questions.question: Which format should captured hook payloads be saved in?

options.label: JSONL
options.description: One JSON object per line in ~/ask-capture.jsonl (current behavior).

options.label: Pretty JSON files
options.description: One indented .json file per payload, in a capture folder.

options.label: CSV
options.description: One row per payload with a timestamp, tool name, and raw JSON column.
